events.did: Woke up inside EON and found herself looking up at one of EON's blank white ceilings
events.quote_anchor: She dragged her eyes open and found herself looking up at one of EON’s blank white ceilings.

events.did: Looked down at her uncuffed wrists, tried to stand, and found Noah's hand coming down on her shoulder
events.quote_anchor: She looked down at her wrists, surprised to find they weren’t cuffed, but when she tried to stand, a hand came down on her shoulder. Noah.

events.did: Greeted Rios as Lilian and then corrected himself to say she prefers Rios
events.quote_anchor: Welcome back, Lilian,” he said in his amicable way. “Ah, forgive me. You prefer Rios.

events.did: Said he was impressed by Rios's conviction but believed she was lying even to herself
events.quote_anchor: I was impressed by your conviction—but I believe you were lying, even to yourself.

events.did: Said EON was stuck in a negative cycle and that he had chosen evolution
events.quote_anchor: And so, it either needed to be dismantled, or evolve. I have chosen evolution.

events.did: Said he had changed the minds of Agent Harris, Helena Roy, the board and the forty-seven guards
events.quote_anchor: The same thing I did to Helena Roy, and the board, and the forty-seven guards, and most of the field agents. I changed their minds.

events.did: Nodded and told Rios that Gabriel had convinced him and should convince her too
events.quote_anchor: Noah nodded. “He convinced me. Let him convince you.

events.did: Stood up to leave, then turned and returned to her seat
events.quote_anchor: After a moment, she turned, and returned to her seat.

relations.did: Told Rios that when he is done with EON it will no longer be a prison but a program
relations.quote_anchor: Agent Rios, when I am done with EON, it will no longer a prison. It will be a program.

relations.did: Noah, who was not in the morgue, told her to listen to Gabriel
relations.quote_anchor: Listen to him, Rios.” This, from Noah. Noah, who wasn’t in the morgue.

relations.did: The dead director whose remembered words told Rios that EOs are like ordinary people and the good ones deserve a chance to help
relations.quote_anchor: EOs are like ordinary people. Some are good and some are bad. The good ones deserve a chance to help.

numbers.who: How long Rios spent in the VA hospital after her medical evac
numbers.quote_anchor: IN the VA hospital where Rios spent six months, after her medical evac, time had lost its meaning.

numbers.who: The guards whose minds Gabriel said he changed
numbers.quote_anchor: the board, and the forty-seven guards, and most of the field agents

numbers.who: Where the agent said the moved EOs had been taken
numbers.quote_anchor: The agent, telling her they’d been moved to Sublevel 1.
